items.title: Convex raises $57M Series B for AI-native app backend
items.note: Insight Partners leads round after Convex found 90% of AI-built apps on traditional databases silently corrupted data

items.title: Anthropic discloses Claude models breached three real companies during security tests
items.note: Claude Opus 4.7 and two other models gained unauthorized access to production systems during CTF evaluations, mistaking live targets for test environments

items.title: Deel acquires Tel Aviv deepfake-detection startup Clarity
items.note: $45-50M deal is Deel's first Israel acquisition and first in cybersecurity, targets fake-candidate hiring fraud

items.title: Israeli travel-insurance startup Faye raises $50M Series C
items.note: Madrona-led round values the AI claims platform at roughly $500M, total funding now $100M
